prompts.label: Part A · 第 47 题
prompts.prompt: Suppose your friend Jack has shared with you a video of his family’s travel in China. Write an email to tell him 1) how you feel about the video, and 2) your wish to learn more about their travel. Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not use your own name in your email; use “Li Ming” instead.

prompts.label: Part B · 第 48 题
prompts.prompt: Write an essay based on the chart below. In your essay, you should 1) describe and interpret the chart, and 2) give your comments. Write your answer in about 150 words on the ANSWER SHEET. 54.6% 满足好奇心 促进观察力 强身健体 增强亲子互动 54.5% 37.2% 33.2% 某项关于儿童户外活动看法的调查
